note: 0.4 dev.38 (Osama, 6 November 2026). BARS is split into three cards. BARS (the RPG squad, unit 616) is its own card at 60: its RPG-7V gunner carries an RPG-26 instead, and the PKM gunner also carries one, so the squad has 6 RPG-26 and no RPG-7V. BARS FS (unit 612, the old fire-support loadout) is its own card at 60 (85 in dev.38; 60 from dev.41): its Kornet is replaced by an AGS-40. BARS Kornet (new unit 721) is a copy of the old fire-support squad with a KPVT in place of the SPG-9, at 100. Availability 4 on each new card is provisional, the same as BARS Igla. Not deployed.
